fieldValues.title: The engine records little about a protocol run and checks less
fieldValues.summary: A protocol run is left out of archives and slices, does not record what a stage produced, and can be advanced to a stage that does not exist or whose dependencies never ran; the spec defines no ProtocolRun and no place for runs in the repository layout.
evidence: srs-rust#1711: runs/runs.json absent from archive pack and slice export; unpacked copy lists no runs
srs-rust#1712: advance to "nonsense" and from stage 1 to stage 10 both succeed
fieldValues.body: The stage history is the provenance of the process. The prototype keeps it as process-step records in the document, which travel; the runner rebuilds the history from them.
